title: Cultivation and a home
odia: ଚାଷ ନାହିଁ ଯା’ର ବାସ ନାହିଁ ତା’ର।
literal_meaning: Whoever has no cultivation has no home.
meaning_odia: ଯାହାର ଚାଷ ନାହିଁ, ତାହାର ବାସ ନାହିଁ—କଥାଟି ଚାଷ ଓ ଘର କରି ରହିବାକୁ ଏକାଠି ବାନ୍ଧୁଛି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଚାଷରୁ ମିଳୁଥିବା ଜୀବିକାକୁ ଘରସଂସାରର ଆଧାର ବୋଲି ଗୁରୁତ୍ୱ ଦିଆଯାଇଛି। ଏହି କଠୋର ଉକ୍ତି ଚାଷ ନ କରୁଥିବା ସମସ୍ତ ଲୋକଙ୍କ ବାସ୍ତବ ସ୍ଥିତିର ବର୍ଣ୍ଣନା ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The rhyme links cultivation with having a home. Read editorially, it stresses the work that sustains a household, using farming as that work. Its absolute formulation belongs to the saying’s agricultural outlook; it does not establish that people in other occupations lack homes.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A household discussing its neglected fields quotes the saying to stress how closely its own home depends on the farming that supports it.
cultural_context: ଚାଷ and ବାସ form a compact rhyme, while ଯା’ର and ତା’ର tie the two clauses to the same person. The structure turns an economic dependence into a memorable categorical statement.

witnesses.locator: Page18, single-line saying beginning ଚାଷ ନାହିଁ, immediately after the roof-rat couplet.
